==Deletion==
This policy proposal has not gone anywhere useful, and I reckon we have left it up long enough.  I regard it as something of an embarrasment and would like to delete it.  There are of course alternatives, but I believe scrapping it would be best.  Of course I am biased, since I really dislike the more complicated alternatives in this proposal.  Anyway, please indicate whether you would support deletion by signing <code><nowiki>*~~~</nowiki></code> below. --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 22:55, 1 June 2006 (UTC)

Rather than deleting it wholesale I'd rather edit it to say why we don't need a formal policy right now. Maybe move this page to a subpage and restart under the same name, with that alternate explanation? I agree this is overkill, presently. Special:Whatlinkshere doesn't seem to show any primary links to this page, so if we want to archive it or mark it inactive/rejected, that'd be fine by me, too. -- ''[[User:Nae'blis|nae]]'[[User_talk:Nae'blis|blis]]'' 22:45, 7 September 2006 (UTC)
